G1722.def:
**ἐν**,
_prep_, (the most frequently of all in NT), with dative (= Heb. בְּ, Lat. in, with _abl.). _
I. Of place, with dative of thing(s), of person(s), **in, within, on, at, by, among**: ἐν τ. πόλει, [[Luk.7.37|Luk.7:37]] τ. οφθαλμῷ, [[Mat.7.3|Mat.7:3]] τ. κοιλίᾳ, [[Mat.12.40|Mat.12:40]] τ. ὄρει, [[2Pe.1.18|2Pe.1:18]] τ. θρόνῳ, [[Rev.3.21|Rev.3:21]] τ. δεξιᾷ τ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.8.34|Rom.8:34]] ἐν ἡμῖν Abbott-Smith has ὑμῖν., [[Luk.1.1|Luk.1:1]] of books, ἐν τ. βιβλίῳ, [[Gal.3.10|Gal.3:10]] τ. νόμῳ, [[Mat.12.5|Mat.12:5]], al.; ἐν τοῖς τ. Πατρός, **in my Father's house** (RV; cf. M, _Pr._, 103), [[Luk.2.49|Luk.2:49]] trop., of the region of thought or feeling, ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ (-αις), [[Mat.5.28|Mat.5:28]], [[2Co.4.6|2Co.4:6]], al.; τ. συνειδήσεσιν, [[2Co.5.11|2Co.5:11]] after verbs of motion, instead of εἰς (constructio praegnans, a usage extended in late Gk. beyond the limits observed in cl.; cf. Bl., §41, 1; M, _Th._, 12), ἀποστέλλω . . . ἐν, [[Mat.10.16|Mat.10:16]] δέδωκεν ἐν τ. χειρί (cf. τιθέναι ἐν χερσί, Hom., _Il._, i, 441, al.), [[Jhn.3.35|Jhn.3:35]] id. after verbs of coming and going (not in cl.), εἰσῆλθε, [[Luk.9.46|Luk.9:46]] ἐξῆλθεν, [[Luk.7.17|Luk.7:17]]
II. Of state, condition, form, occupation, etc.: ἐν ζωῇ, [[Rom.5.10|Rom.5:10]] ἐν τ. θανάτῳ, [[1Jn.3.14|1Jn.3:14]] ἐν πειρασμοῖς, [[1Pe.1.6|1Pe.1:6]] ἐν εἰρήνῃ, [[Mrk.5.25|Mrk.5:25]] ἐν δόξῃ, [[Php.4.19|Php.4:19]] ἐν πραΰτητι, [[Jas.3.13|Jas.3:13]] ἐν μυστηρίῳ, [[1Co.2.7|1Co.2:7]] ἐν τ. διδαχῇ, [[Mrk.4.2|Mrk.4:2]] of a part as contained in a whole, ἐν τ. ἀμπέλῳ, [[Jhn.15.4|Jhn.15:4]] ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι, [[Rom.12.4|Rom.12:4]] of accompanying objects or persons (simple dative in cl.), **with**, ἐν αἵματι, [[Heb.9.25|Heb.9:25]] ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν, [[Luk.14.31|Luk.14:31]] (cf. [[Jude.14|Ju 14]], [[Act.7.14|Act.7:14]]); similarly (cl.), of clothing, armour, arms, ἐν στολαῖς, [[Mrk.12.38|Mrk.12:38]] ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ, [[Jas.2.2|Jas.2:2]] ἐν μαξαίρῃ, [[Luk.22.49|Luk.22:49]] ἐν ῥάβδῳ, [[1Co.4.21|1Co.4:21]] (cf. ἐν τόξοις, Xen., _Mem._, 3, 9, 2); of manner (cl.), ἐν τάχει (= ταχέως), [[Luk.18.8|Luk.18:8]] (cf. Bl., §41, 1); of spiritual influence, ἐν πνεύματι, [[Rom.8.9|Rom.8:9]] ἐν π. ἀκαθάρτῳ, [[Mrk.1.23|Mrk.1:23]] of the mystical relation of the Christian life and the believer himself, **to God and Christ **(cf. _ICC_, _Ro._, 160f.; Mayor on [[Jude.1|Ju 1]]; M, _Pr._, 103): ἐν Χριστῷ, [[Rom.3.24; 6.11|Rom.3:24, 6:11]], [[1Co.3.1; 4.10|1Co.3:1, 4:10]], [[2Co.12.2|2Co.12:2]], [[Gal.2.17|Gal.2:17]], [[Eph.6.21|Eph.6:21]], [[Col.4.7|Col.4:7]], [[1Th.4.16|1Th.4:16]], al.
III. Of the agent, instrument or means (an extension of cl. ἐν of instr.—see LS, see word Ill—corresponding to similar use of Heb. בְּ), **by, with**: ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος (= cl. παρά, C. dative), [[1Co.6.2|1Co.6:2]] ἐν τ. ἄρχοντι τ. δαιμονίων, [[Mat.9.34|Mat.9:34]] ἐν αἵματι, [[Heb.9.22|Heb.9:22]] ἐν ὕδατι, [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]], al.; ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ἀποκτενεῖ (cf. the absol. ἐν μ., ἐν ῥάβδῳ, supr., II, which some would classify here), [[Rev.13.10|Rev.13:10]] ([[Rev.6.8|cf. 6:8]]). Allied to this usage and distinctly Semitic are the following: ἠγόρασας . . . ἐν τ. αἵματι σου (cf. _BDB_, see word בְּ, III, 3), [[Rev.5.9|Rev.5:9]] ὁμολογεῖν ἐν (= Aram. אודי בּ; cf. McNeile on Mt, I.with; M, _Pr._, 104), [[Mat.10.32|Mat.10:32]], [[Luk.12.8|Luk.12:8]]; ὀμνύναι ἐν (= cl. accusative, so [[Jas.5.12|Jas.5:12]]), [[Mat.5.34|Mat.5:34]], al.; also **at the rate of, amounting to**, [[Mrk.4.8|Mrk.4:8]] (WH; vv. ll., εἰς, ἒν), [[Act.7.14|Act.7:14]] (LXX).
IV. Of time,
(a) **in** or **during** a period: ἐν τ. ἡμέρᾳ (νυκτί), [[Jhn.11.9|Jhn.11:9]], al.; ἐν σαββάτῳ, [[Mat.12.2|Mat.12:2]], al.; ἐν τῷ μεταξύ, **meanwhile**, [[Jhn.4.31|Jhn.4:31]]
(b) **at the time of an event**: ἐν τ. παρουσίᾳ, [[1Co.15.23|1Co.15:23]] ἐν τ. ἀναστάσει, [[Mat.22.28|Mat.22:28]]
(with) with art. inf.,
(α) present (so sometimes in cl., but not as in NT = ἕως; V. M, _Pr._, 215), **while**: [[Mat.13.4|Mat.13:4]], [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[Gal.4.18|Gal.4:18]], al.;
(β) aor., **when, after**: [[Luk.9.36|Luk.9:36]], al.;
(d) **within** (cl.): [[Mat.27.40|Mat.27:40]],
V. **In composition**: (1) meaning: (a) with adjectives, it signifies usually the possession of a quality, as ἐνάλιος, ἐν́δοξος; (b) with verbs, continuance in (before ἐν) or motion into (before εἰς), as ἐμμένω, ἐμβαίνω. (ii) Assimilation: ἐν becomes ἐμ- before β, μ, π, φ, ψ; ἐγ- before γ, κ, ξ, χ; ἐλ- before λ. But in the older MSS of NT, followed by modern editions, assimilation is sometimes neglected, as in ἐνγράφω, ἐγκαινίζω, etc.
(AS)

G1760.def:
**ἐνθυμέομαι**, -οῦμαι
(θυμός), [in LXX for דָּמָה pi., etc. ;]
**to reflect on, ponder**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.1.20; 9.4|Mat.1:20 9:4]].†
(AS)

G1781.def:
**ἐν-τέλλω **
[in LXX, as in NT (and mostly in Hdt.), always mid., chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;]
**-ομαι, to command, enjoin, instruct**: before περί [[Heb.11.22|Heb.11:22]] with inf., [[Mat.19.7|Mat.19:7]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.1.2|Act.1:2]] οὕτως, [[Act.13.47|Act.13:47]] καθώς, [[Jhn.14.31|Jhn.14:31]] (ἐντολὴν ἔδωκεν, WH); before λέγων, [[Mat.17.9|Mat.17:9]] with inf., [[Jhn.8.5|Jhn.8:5]] ἵνα, [[Mrk.13.34|Mrk.13:34]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.28.20|Mat.28:20]], [[Mrk.10.3|Mrk.10:3]], [[Jhn.15.14, 17|Jhn.15:14, 17]]; before περί, with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.4.6|Mat.4:6]] and [[Luk.4.10|Luk.4:10]] (LXX); διαθήκην ἐ. πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Heb.9.20|Heb.9:20]] (LXX) (cf. [[Sir.45.3|Sir.45:3]]).†
_SYN._:
κελεύω, **to command**, of verbal orders in general;
παραγγέλλω, to charge, esp. of the transmitted orders of a military com­mander; ἐντέλλω points rather to the contents of the command (see Thayer, see word κελεύω)
(AS)

G1777.def:
**ἔνοχος**, -ον (= ἐνεχόμενος),
(in LXX for רָשַׁע hi., etc. ;]
1. **held in, bound by**: with genitive (cl. with dative), δουλείας, [[Heb.2.15|Heb.2:15]]
2. **In law-phrases **
(a) **liable to a charge or action **(cl. with dative, of crime): with dative, of the tribunal (MM, _Exp._, xiii), [[Mat.5.21-22;|Mat.5:21-22]] before εἰς (Field, _Notes_, 4 f.), [[Mat.5.22|Mat.5:22]]
(b) with genitive, of the punishment ([[Gen.26.11|Gen.26:11]]): θανάτου, [[Mat.26.66|Mat.26:66]], [[Mrk.14.64|Mrk.14:64]];
(with) with genitive (cl. with dative„ rarely with prep.; MM, _Exp._, xiii), of the crime ([[2Ma.13.6|2Ma.13:6]]): [[Mrk.3.29|Mrk.3:29]];
(d) with genitive, of the thing injured, **guilty **(absol., in Cl.): [[1Co.11.27|1Co.11:27]], [[Jas.2.10|Jas.2:10]] (cf. [[Isa.54.17|Isa.54:17]] _DB_, ii, 268a).†
(AS)

G1746.def:
**ἐν-δύω**
(ἐνδύνω, [[2Ti.3.6|2Ti.3:6]]), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;]
1. with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.27.28|Mat.27:28]] (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, [[Mat.27.31|Mat.27:31]], [[Mrk.15.20|Mrk.15:20]], [[Luk.15.22|Luk.15:22]]; mid., **to put on oneself, be clothed with**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.6.25|Mat.6:25]], [[Mrk.6.9|Mrk.6:9]], [[Luk.8.27; 12.22|Luk.8:27 12:22]], [[Act.12.21|Act.12:21]]; ptcp., [[Mat.22.11|Mat.22:11]], [[Mrk.1.6|Mrk.1:6]], [[2Co.5.3|2Co.5:3]], [[Rev.1.13; 15.6; 19.14|Rev.1:13 15:6 19:14]]; of armour (figuratively): [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]], [[Eph.6.11, 14|Eph.6:11, 14]], [[1Th.5.8|1Th.5:8]]; metaphorically, δύναμιν, [[Luk.24.49|Luk.24:49]] ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, [[1Co.15.53-54;|1Co.15:53-54]] τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, [[Eph.4.24|Eph 4:24]], [[Col.3.10|Col.3:10]]; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]] Ἰησ. Χριστόν, [[Rom.13.14|Rom.13:14]], [[Gal.3.27|Gal.3:27]],
2. **to enter, press into**: [[2Ti.3.6|2Ti.3:6]] (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†
(AS)

G1761.def:
**ἐνθύμησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνθυμέομαι), [in Sm.: [[Job.21.27|Job.21:27]], [[Ezk.11.21|Eze.11:21]] * ;]
**consideration, pondering **(EV, device): [[Act.17.29|Act.17:29]] pl., **thoughts, feel­ings**: [[Mat.9.4; 12.25|Mat.9:4 12:25]], [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]].†
_SYN._: ἔννοια, the action of the reason; while ἐνθ. is rather that of the affections (cf. Westc., _Heb._, l.with) (AS)

G1706.def:
**ἐμ-πίπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
**to fall into**: before εἰς, [[Mat.12.11|Mat.12:11]], [[Luk.6.39; 10.36|Luk.6:39 10:36]]; metaphorically, εἰς κρίμα, [[1Ti.3.6|1Ti.3:6]] ὀνειδισμόν [[1Ti.3.7|1Ti.3:7]] πειρασμόν, [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]] εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ (cf. [[2Ki.24.14|2Ki.24:14]], [[1Ch.21.13|1Ch.21:13]], [[Sir.2.18|Sir.2:18]]), [[Heb.10.31|Heb.10:31]].†
(AS)

G1713.def:
**ἔμ-πορος**, -ου, ὁ
(πόρος, a journey), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר, רָכַל ;]
1. a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey.
2. **a merchant**: [[Mat.13.45|Mat.13:45]], [[Rev.18.3, 11; 18.15, 23|Rev.18:3, 11 18:15, 23]].†
(AS)

G1754.def:
**ἐνεργέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Num.8.24|Num.8:24]] B (עֲבֹדָה צָבָא), [[Isa.41.4|Isa.41:4]], [[Pro.21.6|Pro.21:6]] (פָּעַל), [[Pro.31.12|Pro.31:12]] (גָּמַל), I [[Est.2.20|Est.2:20]], [[Wis.15.11; 16.17|Wis.15:11 16:17]] * ;] (for full lexical treatment, see AR, _Eph._, 243 ff.);
1. intrans., **to be at work or in action, to operate **(opposite to ἀργέω): before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[Mat.14.2|Mat.14:2]], [[Mrk.6.14|Mrk.6:14]], [[Eph.2.2|Eph.2:2]]; with dative of person(s), before εἰς (Lft., in l), [[Gal.2.8|Gal.2:8]]
2. Trans., **to work, effect, do**: with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.12.11|1Co.12:11]], [[Eph.1.11|Eph.1:11]]; id, before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[1Co.12.6|1Co.12:6]], [[Gal.3.5|Gal.3:5]], [[Php.2.13|Php.2:13]]; ἐ. ἐνέργειαν, [[Eph.1.19-20|Eph.1:19-20]] Pass. (taken as mid. by Lft., _Ga._, 204 f.; but see AR, _Eph._, l.with; Milligan, _Th._, 28 f.; Mayor, _Ja._, 177 ff.), in NT, "always used of some principle or power at work" (Meyer), **to be actuated, set in operation**: [[2Th.2.7|2Th.2:7]] before ἐν, [[Rom.7.5|Rom.7:5]], [[2Co.1.6; 4.12|2Co.1:6 4:12]], [[Eph.3.20|Eph.3:20]], [[Col.1.29|Col.1:29]], [[1Th.2.13|1Th.2:13]]; before διά, with genitive of thing(s), [[Gal.5.6|Gal.5:6]] ἐνεργουμένη (M, _Pr._, 156), [[Jas.5.16|Jas.5:16]] (Cremer, 262).†
(AS)

G1727.def:
**ἐν-αντίος**, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;]
**over against, opposite, contrary**: ἄνεμος, [[Mat.14.24|Mat.14:24]], [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[Act.27.4|Act.27:4]]; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, [[Psa.42.1-11|Psa.42:1-11]]), with genitive, [[Mrk.15.39|Mrk.15:39]] Metaphorical, **opposed, hostile**: [[1Th.2.15|1Th.2:15]], [[Act.26.9; 28.17|Act.26:9 28:17]]; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., [[Tit.2.8|Tit.2:8]] Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, **before, in the presence of**: [[Luk.1.6; 20.26; 24.19|Luk.1:6 20:26 24:19]] [[Act.7.10|Act.7:10]] (ἔναντι, T), [[Act.8.32|Act.8:32]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1768.def:
**ἐννενήκοντα**, see: ἐνεν-.
**ἐνενήκοντα** (Rec. ἐννεν-), οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl.,
**ninety**: [[Mat.18.12-13|Mat.18:12-13]], [[Luk.15.4|Luk.15:4]], 7.†
(AS)

G1788.def:
**ἐν-τρέπω **
[in LXX for כָּנַע ni., כָּלַם ni., etc. ;]
**to turn about**; metaphorically, **put to shame**: with accusative, [[1Co.4.14|1Co.4:14]] pass., [[2Th.3.14|2Th.3:14]], [[Tit.2.8|Tit.2:8]]; mid., **to reverence**: with accusative of person(s) (cl. with genitive), [[Mat.21.37|Mat.21:37]], [[Mrk.12.6|Mrk.12:6]], [[Luk.18.2, 4; 20.13|Luk.18:2, 4 20:13]], [[Heb.12.9|Heb.12:9]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, iii, xiii).†
(AS)

G1711.def:
**ἐμπορία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX for סָחַר, רָכַל etc. ;]
**commerce, business, trade**: [[Mat.22.5|Mat.22:5]]†
(AS)

G1714.def:
**ἐμ-πίπρημι**,
ἐμπρήθω (for the form, see: ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, see word πίμπρημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף ;]
**to set on fire**: πόλιν, [[Mat.22.7|Mat.22:7]] pass., of the body, **to become inflamed**: [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]] (T; πίμπρημι WH, which see).†
(AS)

G1787.def:
**ἐντός**
(ἐν),
_adv._, [in LXX: [[Job.18.20|Job.18:20]], [[Psa.39.3; 109.22|Psa.39:3 109:22]], [[Sng.3.10|Sng.3:10]]; ὁ, τὸ, τὰ ἐ., [[Psa.103.1|Psa.103:1]], [[Isa.16.11|Isa.16:11]], Da TH [[Dan.10.16|Dan.10:16]], [[Sir.19.26|Sir.19:26]], [[1Ma.4.48|1Ma.4:48]] * ;]
**within**: with genitive, ἐ. ὑμῶν, within you (i.e. in your hearts, R, txt.), or among you (R, mg.), [[Luk.17.21|Luk.17:21]] (cf. Field, _Notes_, 71; Thayer, see word; _ICC_, Lk, l.with; Dalman, _Words_, 145 ff.); τὸ ἐ., [[Mat.23.26|Mat.23:26]]†
(AS)

G1779.def:
**ἐνταφιάζω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.50.2|Gen.50:2]] (חָנַט; cf. ἐνταφιαστής, [[Gen.50.2|Gen.50:2]] for רָפָא; see Deiss., BS, 120 f.; MM, _Exp._, xiii)* ;]
a κοινή word (Deiss., _LAE_, 723),
**to prepare for burial**: [[Mat.26.12|Mat.26:12]], [[Jhn.19.40|Jhn.19:40]].†
(AS)

G1716.def:
**ἐμ-πτύω **
[in LXX: before εἰς, [[Num.12.14|Num.12:14]] A, [[Deu.25.9|Deu.25:9]] (יָרָק)* ;]
= cl., καταπτύω (Ruth., _NPhr._, 66),
**to spit upon**: with dative, [[Mrk.10.34; 14.65; 15.19|Mrk.10:34 14:65 15:19]]; before εἰς, [[Mat.26.67; 27.30|Mat.26:67 27:30]]. Pass., [[Luk.18.32|Luk.18:32]]†
(AS)

G1718.def:
**ἐμφανίζω **
[in LXX for יָדַע hi., etc. ;]
1. **to manifest, exhibit**: ἐαυτόν, with dative of person(s), [[Jhn.14.21-22|Jhn.14:21-22]] (_DCG_, ii, 112b). Pass. and mid., **to show oneself, appear**: [[Mat.27.53|Mat.27:53]], [[Heb.9.24|Heb.9:24]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xii).
2. **to declare, make known**: before ὅτι, [[Heb.11.14|Heb.11:14]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.23.15|Act.23:15]] with accusative of thing(s), before πρός, [[Act.23.22|Act.23:22]] κατά, with genitive of person(s), [[Act.24.1; 25.2|Act.24:1 25:2]]; περί, [[Act.25.15|Act.25:15]]†
_SYN._: δηλόω, q.v (AS)

G1794.def:
**ἐν-τυλίσσω **
to wrap up (LS), **roll or coil about **(_DCG_, ii, 227, 507a): with accusative and dative, [[Mat.27.59|Mat.27:59]] (iv, Tr. [WH], cf. similar sentence in π.; MM, _Exp._, xiii), [[Luk.23.53|Luk.23:53]] pass., [[Jhn.20.7|Jhn.20:7]]†
(AS)

G1733.def:
**ἕν-δεκα**, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
**eleven**: of the eleven apostles, οἱ, ἕ., [[Mat.28.16|Mat.28:16]], [[Mrk.16.14|Mrk.16:14]], [[Luk.24.9, 33|Luk.24:9, 33]], [[Act.1.26; 2.14|Act.1:26 2:14]].†
(AS)

G1773.def:
**ἔννυχος**, -ον
(νύξ), [in LXX: [[3Ma.5.5|3Ma.5:5]] * ;] (in cl. poët.; prose in late Gk. only)
nightly. Neut., adverbially, ἔννυχα (Rec. -χον), **by night**: [[Mrk.1.35|Mrk.1:35]]†
(AS)

G1758.def:
**ἐν-έχω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.49.23|Gen.49:23]] (סָתַם), [[Ezk.14.4|Eze.14:4]], 7, [[3Ma.6.10|3Ma.6:10]] * ;]
1. **to hold in**; pass., **to be held, entangled**: with dative of thing(s); jig., ζυγῷ δουλείας, [[Gal.5.1|Gal.5:1]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xii); θλίψρεσιν, [[2Th.1.4|2Th.1:4]] (cf. ἀσεβείσιν, 3Mac, l.with).
2. **to set oneself against, be urgent against **(as Ge, l.with; for con­struction, see Swete, _Mk._, l.with): [[Mrk.6.19|Mrk.6:19]], [[Luk.11.53|Luk.11:53]].†
(AS)

G1723.def:
**ἐν-αγκαλίζομαι**
(ἀγκάλη), [in LXX for חִבֻּק pi., [[Pro.6.10; 24.33|Pro.6:10 24:33]] * ;]
**to take into one's arms**: [[Mrk.9.36; 10.16|Mrk.9:36 10:16]].†
(AS)

G1737.def:
**ἐνδιδύσκω **
[in LXX: [[2Ki.1.24; 13.18|2Ki.1:24 13:18]], [[Pro.31.21|Pro.31:21]] (לָבַשׁ), [[Jdt.9.1; 10.3|Jdth.9:1 10:3]], [[Sir.50.11|Sir.50:11]] * ;]
**to put on**: with dupl. accusative, [[Mrk.15.17|Mrk.15:17]] (ἐνδύουσι, Rec.). Mid., **to put on oneself, be clothed in**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.16.19|Luk.16:19]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xii).†
(AS)

G1750.def:
**ἐν-ειλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX [[1Sa.21.9|1Ki.21:9]] לוּט * ;]
**to roll in, wind in**: with accusative of person(s) and dative of thing(s), [[Mrk.15.46|Mrk.15:46]]†
(AS)

G1726.def:
**ἐν-αντίος**, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;]
**over against, opposite, contrary**: ἄνεμος, [[Mat.14.24|Mat.14:24]], [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[Act.27.4|Act.27:4]]; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, [[Psa.42.1-11|Psa.42:1-11]]), with genitive, [[Mrk.15.39|Mrk.15:39]] Metaphorical, **opposed, hostile**: [[1Th.2.15|1Th.2:15]], [[Act.26.9; 28.17|Act.26:9 28:17]]; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., [[Tit.2.8|Tit.2:8]] Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, **before, in the presence of**: [[Luk.1.6; 20.26; 24.19|Luk.1:6 20:26 24:19]] [[Act.7.10|Act.7:10]] (ἔναντι, T), [[Act.8.32|Act.8:32]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1725.def:
**ἔν-αντι **
_adv._,
a κοινή word (MM, _Exp._, xii),
**before**; as prep., with genitive: [[Luk.1.8|Luk.1:8]], [[Act.7.10|Act.7:10]] (WH, ἐναντίον), [[Act.8.21|Act.8:21]]†
(AS)

G1799.def:
**ἐνώπιος**, -ον
(ὤψ), [in LXX for פָּנִים, etc. ;]
face to face, in sight (Theocr.; ἄρτοι ἐ., [[Exo.25.29|Exo.25:29]]): neut., ἐνώπιον, in vernacular, with force of prep. with genitive [in LXX for פָּנִים, עַיִן, etc., cf. Dalman, _Words_, 31 f., 209 f., and Deiss., BS., 213], in NT, most frequently in Lk, Ac, Re, never in Mt, Mk, **before, in the presence of**: [[Luk.1.19|Luk.1:19]] [[Luk.4.7|Luk.4:7]], [[Act.4.10|Act.4:10]] [[Act.6.5|Act.6:5]], [[Rev.1.4; 2.14|Rev.1:4 2:14]], al.; esp. ἐ. Κυρίου (θεοῦ), in the sight of God, or with God as witness or as judge, [[Rom.14.22|Rom.14:22]], [[1Co.1.29|1Co.1:29]], [[1Ti.2.3|1Ti.2:3]], [[Jas.4.10|Jas.4:10]], [[1Pe.3.4|1Pe.3:4]], al.
(AS)

G1705.def:
**ἐμ-πίπλημι**
(on ἐμπίμπ-, see LS, see word, Bl., § 6, 8), and ἐμπιπλάω ([[Act.14.17|Act.14:17]]), [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, שָׂבַע ;]
**to fill full, fill up, satisfy**: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), [[Luk.1.53|Luk.1:53]], [[Act.14.17|Act.14:17]]; pass., [[Luk.6.25|Luk.6:25]], [[Jhn.6.12|Jhn.6:12]]; metaphorically, with genitive of person(s), **to take one's fill of**: [[Rom.15.24|Rom.15:24]] (cf. Dan LXX Su 32).†
(AS)

G1770.def:
**ἐν-νεύω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.6.13; 10.10|Pro.6:13 10:10]] (קָרַץ), [[Sir.27.22|Sir.27:22]] A * ;]
**to nod to, make a sign to**: with dative of person(s), [[Luk.1.62|Luk.1:62]]†
(AS)

G1782.def:
**ἐντεῦθεν **
_adv._ (ἔνθεν), [in LXX chiefly for זֶה ;]
1. **of place, hence**: [[Luk.4.9; 13.31|Luk.4:9 13:31]], [[Jhn.2.16; 7.3; 14.31; 18.36|Jhn.2:16 7:3 14:31 18:36]]; ἐ. καὶ ἐ. (for cl. ἔνθεν κ. ἔνθεν), on this side and on that, on each side, [[Jhn.19.18|Jhn.19:18]] similarly, ἐ. καὶ ἐκεῖθεν, [[Rev.22.2|Rev.22:2]]
2. Of time, thereupon.
3. **Causal; hence, therefore**: [[Jas.4.1|Jas.4:1]]†
ἔνθεν,
_adv._, [in LXX for זֶה, פֹּה, etc. ;]
**hence**: [[Mat.17.20|Mat.17:20]], [[Luk.16.26|Luk.16:26]].†
(AS)

G1763.def:
**ἐνιαυτός**, -oῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for שָׁנֶה ;]
1. prop., a cycle of time.
2. **= ἔτος, a year**: [[Jhn.11.49, 51; 18.13|Jhn.11:49, 51 18:13]], [[Act.11.26; 18.11|Act.11:26 18:11]], [[Jas.5.17|Jas.5:17]], [[Rev.9.15|Rev.9:15]]; pl., of sabbatical years, [[Gal.4.10|Gal.4:10]] ποιεῖν ἐ., to spend a year, [[Jas.4.13|Jas.4:13]]ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐ., [[Heb.9.7|Heb.9:7]] κατ᾽ ἐ., [[Heb.9.25; 10.1, 3|Heb.9:25 10:1, 3]]; ἐ. δεκτόν, [[Luk.4.19|Luk.4:19]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1776.def:
**ἐν-οχλέω**, -ῶ
(ὄχλος), [in LXX for חָלָה ;]
**to trouble**: with accusative, [[Heb.12.15|Heb.12:15]] Pass., before ἀπό, [[Luk.6.18|Luk.6:18]]†
(AS)

G1784.def:
**ἔντιμος**, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX for חוֹר, etc. ;]
**honoured, prized, precious**: of persons, [[Luk.7.2|Luk.7:2]], [[Php.2.29|Php.2:29]]; compar., [[Luk.14.8|Luk.14:8]] of things, metaphorically, λίθος, [[1Pe.2.4; 2.6|1Pe.2:4 2:6]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G1741.def:
**ἔνδοξος**, -ον
(δόξα [in LXX for כָּבַד, etc. ;]
1. **held in honour, of high repute**: [[1Co.4.10|1Co.4:10]]
2. **glorious, splendid**: of deeds, τά ἔ., [[Luk.13.17|Luk.13:17]] of clothing, [[Luk.7.25|Luk.7:25]] Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία, [[Eph.5.27|Eph.5:27]] (cf. παράδοξος).†
(AS)

G1751.def:
**ἔν-ειμι **
1. to be in, within ([[Job.27.3|Job.27:3]], al.): ptcp. pl., τὰ ἐνόντα, [[Luk.11.41|Luk.11:41]] (R, txt., cf. MM, _Exp._, xii).
2. **to be possible**: [[Luk.11.41|Luk.11:41]] (R, mg.).†
(AS)

G1748.def:
**ἐνεδρεύω**
(ἐνέδρα), [in LXX chiefly for אָרַב ;]
**to lie in wait for**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.11.54|Luk.11:54]], [[Act.23.21|Act.23:21]].†
(AS)

G1735.def:
**έν-δέχομαι **
[in LXX: [[Psa.119.122|Psa.119:122]] (עָרַב), [[2Ma.11.18|2Ma.11:18]] * ;]
1. to admit, approve.
2. **to be possible**; impers., ἑνδέχεται, **it is possible**: with accusative and inf., [[Luk.13.33|Luk.13:33]] (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)

G1765.def:
**ἐν-ισχύω **
[in LXX for חָזַק, etc. ;]
**to strengthen**: in spiritual sense, [[Luk.22.43|Luk.22:43]] pass., [[Act.9.19|Act.9:19]] (Rec. ἐνισχύσεν, became strong, as in LXX, [[Gen.12.10; 48.2|Gen.12:10 48:2]], al.).†
(AS)

G1712.def:
**ἐμπόριον**, -ον, τό
(ἔμπορος) [in LXX: [[Deu.33.19|Deu.33:19]] (סָפַן), [[Ezk.27.3|Eze.27:3]] (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, [[Isa.23.17|Isa.23:17]] (זָנָה)* ;]
**a trading place, exchange**: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, [[Jhn.2.16|Jhn.2:16]]†
(AS)

G1720.def:
**ἐμ-φυσάω**, -ῶ
(φυσάω, to blow), [in LXX for נָפַח, etc. ;]
to breathe into (cf. [[Gen.2.7|Gen.2:7]], [[Wis.15.11|Wis.15:11]], a1.), **breathe upon**: [[Jhn.20.22|Jhn.20:22]]†
(AS)

G1798.def:
**ἐνύπνιον**, -ου, τό
(ὕπνος), [in LXX chiefly for חֲלוֹם ;]
**a dream**: pl., [[Act.2.17|Act.2:17]]†
(AS)

G1797.def:
**ἐνυπνιάζω**
(ἐνύπνιον), [in LXX, as in NT, -ομαι, depon., chiefly for חָלַם ;]
**to dream**: ἐνυπνίοις ἐ., [[Act.2.17|Act.2:17]] (LXX); present ptcp., [[Jude.8|Ju 8]].†
(AS)

G1757.def:
**ἐν-ευλογέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ ;]
**to bless**: pass., before ἐν, [[Act.3.25|Act.3:25]] (LXX), [[Gal.3.8|Gal.3:8]] (LXX) (Cremer, 770).†
(AS)

G1729.def:
**ἐνδεής**, -ές
(ἐνδέω, to lack) [in LXX for חָסֵר, אֶבְיוֹן, etc. ;]
**in want, needy**: [[Act.4.34|Act.4:34]],†
(AS)

G1709.def:
**ἐν-πνέω**, -ῶ
(Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: [[Deu.20.16|Deu.20:16]], [[Jos.10.28|Jos.10:28]] ff. [[Jos.11.11, 14|Jos.11:11, 14]] (ptcp. neut., for נֶפֶשׁ, נְשָׁמָה), [[Wis.15.11|Wis.15:11]] * ;]
1. to breathe on.
2. **to breathe**;
(a) absol.;
(b) with genitive part.: figuratively, ἀπειλῆς κ. φόνου, [[Act.9.1|Act.9:1]]†
(AS)

G1769.def:
**ἐνεός**
(Rec. ἐνν-), -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX: [[Isa.56.10|Isa.56:10]] (אִלֵּם), Ep. [[Jer.41.1-18;|Jer.41:1-18]] ἐ. ποιεῖν, [[Pro.17.28|Pro.17:28]] * ;]
**dumb, speechless**: [[Act.9.7|Act.9:7]]†
(AS)

G1743.def:
**ἐν-δυναμόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Jdg.6.34|Jdg.6:34]], [[1Ch.12.18|1Ch.12:18]] A (לָבַשׁ), [[Psa.52.7|Psa.52:7]] (עָזַז)* ;]
**to make strong, strengthen**: with accusative, of person(s), [[Php.4.13|Php.4:13]], [[1Ti.1.12|1Ti.1:12]], [[2Ti.4.17|2Ti.4:17]]. Pass., [[Act.9.22|Act.9:22]] C. dative, [[Rom.4.20|Rom.4:20]] before ἐν, [[2Ti.2.1|2Ti.2:1]] (ἐν Κυρίῳ), [[Eph.6.10|Eph.6:10]] (Cremer, 221).†
(AS)

G1717.def:
**ἐμφανής**, -ές
(ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), [in LXX: [[Mic.4.1|Mic.4:1]], [[Isa.2.2|Isa.2:2]] (כּוּן ni.), [[Wis.6.22; 7.21; 14.17|Wis.6:22 7:21 14:17]]; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, [[Exo.2.14|Exo.2:14]] (יָדַע ni.), [[Isa.65.1|Isa.65:1]] (דָּרַשׁ ni.)* ;]
**manifest**: [[Act.10.40|Act.10:40]] metaphorically, [[Rom.10.20|Rom.10:20]] (LXX) (see: ἐπιφανής).†
(AS)

G1772.def:
**ἔν-νομος**, -ον
[in LXX: Sir, [[Pro.1.1-33|Pro.1:1-33]] ogue 12* ;]
1. **lawful, legal **(MM, _Exp._, xiii): [[Act.19.39|Act.19:39]]
2. **Of persons, **
(a) **law-abiding**;
(b) **under law**: ἔ. Χριστοῦ, in relation to Christ, [[1Co.9.21|1Co.9:21]] (Cremer. 435).†
(AS)

G1747.def:
**ἐν-έδρα**, -ας, ἡ
(ἕδρα, a seat), [in LXX: [[Jos.8.7-9|Jos.8:7-9]], [[Psa.10.8|Psa.10:8]] (אָרַב)* ;]
**a lying in wait, an ambush**: [[Act.23.16|Act.23:16]] (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), [[Act.25.8|Act.25:8]]†
(AS)

G1793.def:
**ἐν-τυγχάνω **
[in LXX: Da TH [[Dan.6.12-13|Dan.6:12-13]] (קֶרֶב) [[Wis.8.20; 16.28|Wis.8:20 16:28]], [[2Ma.2.25|2Ma.2:25]] [[2Mac.4.36|2Mac 4:36]] [[2Mac.6.12|2Mac 6:12]] [[2Mac.15.39|2Mac 15:39]], [[3Ma.6.37|3Ma.6:37]]; before κατά, [[1Ma.8.32|1Ma.8:32]] [[1Mac.10.61-64|1Mac 10:61-64]] [[1Mac.11.25|1Mac 11:25]] * ;]
1. to fall in with.
2. to meet with in order to converse.
3. **to petition, make petition**: with dative of person(s), before ὑπέρ with genitive of person(s), [[Act.25.24|Act.25:24]] (cf. Field, _Notes_, 140), [[Heb.7.25|Heb.7:25]], [[Rom.8.27, 34|Rom.8:27, 34]] (θεῷ, not expressed); before κατά, **against**: [[Rom.11.2|Rom.11:2]] (cf. ἔντευξις, ὑπερ-εντυγχάνω).†
(AS)

G1731.def:
**ἐν-δείκνυμι **
[in LXX for לָכַד, גָּמַל, רָאָה hi. ;]
to mark, point out. Mid„
1. **to show forth, prove**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Rom.2.15; 9.22|Rom.2:15 9:22]], [[Eph.2.7|Eph.2:7]], [[Tit.2.10; 3.2|Tit.2:10 3:2]], [[Heb.6.11|Heb.6:11]]; before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[Rom.9.17|Rom.9:17]] (LXX), [[1Ti.1.16|1Ti.1:16]] before εἰς, [[Heb.6.10|Heb.6:10]] (with cogn. accusative), [[2Co.8.24|2Co.8:24]]
2. **to manifest **(by act): with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[2Ti.4.14|2Ti.4:14]] (cf. [[Gen.50.15, 17|Gen.50:15, 17]], and see MM, _Exp._, xiii).†
(AS)

G1732.def:
**ἔν-δειξις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνδείκνυμι),
**a pointing out, showing forth, proof **(see: ἔνδειγμα): [[Rom.3.25-26|Rom.3:25-26]], [[2Co.8.24|2Co.8:24]], [[Php.1.28|Php.1:28]].†
(AS)

G1774.def:
**ἐν-οικέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly (29/36) for יָשַׁב ;]
**to dwell in**; metaphorically, before ἐν, with dative of person(s): ὁ θεός, [[2Co.6.16|2Co.6:16]] τ. πνεῦμα, [[Rom.8.11|Rom.8:11]], [[2Ti.1.14|2Ti.1:14]]; ὁ λόγος, [[Col.3.16|Col.3:16]] πίστις, [[2Ti.1.5|2Ti.1:5]] ἁμαρτία, [[Rom.7.17|Rom.7:17]]†
(AS)

G1764.def:
**ἐν-ίστημι **
[in LXX: [[2Ki.13.6|4Ki.13:6]] A (עֶמְדָּה), [[3Ki.12.24|3Ki.12:24]], [[1Es.5.47|1Es.5:47]] [[Est.9.6|Est.9:6]], [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]], 1; [[4Ma.9.1-32|4Ma.9.1-32]] * ;]
**to place in**; in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and in mid., intrans.;
(a) **to be at hand, impend, threaten**: [[2Ti.3.1|2Ti.3:1]]
(b) **to be present**: [[2Th.2.2|2Th.2:2]] (but see Thayer, see word); pf. ptcp., present: [[1Co.7.26|1Co.7:26]], [[Gal.1.4|Gal.1:4]], [[Heb.9.9|Heb.9:9]]; pl., [[Rom.8.38|Rom.8:38]], [[1Co.3.22|1Co.3:22]] (Cremer, 3O9).†
(AS)

G1762.def:
**ἔνι ** Ionic form of ἐν (ἐνί), with strengthened accent;
[in LXX: [[Sir.37.2|Sir.37:2]], [[4Ma.4.22|4Ma.4:22]] * ;]
= ἔνεστι,
**is in, has place, can be**: [[1Co.6.5|1Co.6:5]], [[Gal.3.28|Gal.3:28]] (tris) [[Col.3.11|Col.3:11]], [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]] (cf. Lft., _Ga._; Hort and Mayor, _Ja._, ll. with).†
(AS)

G1756.def:
**ἐνεργής**, -ές
(late form of ἐνεργός, on WH. cf. AR, _Eph._, 241),
**at work, active, effective**: [[1Co.16.9|1Co.16:9]], Phm 6, [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]] (Cremer, 261).†
(AS)

G1795.def:
**ἐν-τυπόω**, -ῶ
(τύπος), [in LXX for פִּתּוּחַ, [[Exo.39.30|Exo.39:30]]) A * ;]
**to imprint, engrave**: pass. ptcp., with dative, [[2Co.3.7|2Co.3:7]]†
(AS)

G1736.def:
**ἐνδημέω**, -ῶ
(ἔνδημος, living in a place),
**to live in a place, be at home**: ἐν τ. σώματι, [[2Co.5.6; 5.9|2Co.5:6 5:9]]; πρὸς τ. Kύριον, [[2Co.5.8|2Co.5:8]]†
(AS)

G1704.def:
**ἐν-περι-πατέω**, -ῶ
(Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: [[Lev.26.12|Lev.26:12]] [[Job.1.7|Job.1:7]], al. (הָלַךְ hithp.), [[Wis.19.21|Wis.19:21]] ;]
**to walk about in or among**: before ἐν., dative of person(s), [[2Co.6.16|2Co.6:16]] (LXX),†
(AS)

G1728.def:
**ἐν-άρχομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for חָלַל hi. ;]
**to begin, make a beginning**: [[Gal.3.3|Gal.3:3]], [[Php.1.6|Php.1:6]].†
(AS)

G1730.def:
**ἔν-δειγμα**, -τος
(ἐνδείκνυμι),
**a plain token, proof**: [[2Th.1.5|2Th.1:5]] (cf. ἔνδειξις, which refers rather to the "act of proving"; ἔ., with the passive formation, to the thing proved, see Lft., _Notes_, 100; M, _Th._, l.with).†
_SYN._: τεκμήριον (AS)

G1783.def:
**ἐν-τευξις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐντυγχάνω, which see), [in LXX: [[2Ma.4.3|2Ma.4:3]] * ;]
1. a lighting upon, meeting with.
2. conversation.
3. **a petition **(in this sense common in π.; cf. Deiss., BS, 121 f., 146; MM, _Exp._, iii): [[1Ti.4.5|1Ti.4:5]] p1., [[1Ti.2.1|1Ti.2:1]]†
_SYN._: δέησις (which see) (AS)

G1789.def:
**ἐν-τρέφω **
**to train up, nurture**; pass., metaphorically, τοῖς λόγοις τ. πίστεως, [[1Ti.4.6|1Ti.4:6]]†
(AS)

G1707.def:
**ἐμ-πλέκω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.28.18|Pro.28:18]] (נָפַל), [[2Ma.15.17|2Ma.15:17]] * ;]
**to weave in, entwine**; pass., metaphorically, **to be involved, entangled in**: [[2Ti.2.4|2Ti.2:4]], [[2Pe.2.20|2Pe.2:20]].†
(AS)

G1744.def:
**ἐν-δύνω**, see: ἐνδύω.
**ἐν-δύω**
(ἐνδύνω, [[2Ti.3.6|2Ti.3:6]]), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;]
1. with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.27.28|Mat.27:28]] (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, [[Mat.27.31|Mat.27:31]], [[Mrk.15.20|Mrk.15:20]], [[Luk.15.22|Luk.15:22]]; mid., **to put on oneself, be clothed with**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.6.25|Mat.6:25]], [[Mrk.6.9|Mrk.6:9]], [[Luk.8.27; 12.22|Luk.8:27 12:22]], [[Act.12.21|Act.12:21]]; ptcp., [[Mat.22.11|Mat.22:11]], [[Mrk.1.6|Mrk.1:6]], [[2Co.5.3|2Co.5:3]], [[Rev.1.13; 15.6; 19.14|Rev.1:13 15:6 19:14]]; of armour (figuratively): [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]], [[Eph.6.11, 14|Eph.6:11, 14]], [[1Th.5.8|1Th.5:8]]; metaphorically, δύναμιν, [[Luk.24.49|Luk.24:49]] ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, [[1Co.15.53-54;|1Co.15:53-54]] τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, [[Eph.4.24|Eph 4:24]], [[Col.3.10|Col.3:10]]; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]] Ἰησ. Χριστόν, [[Rom.13.14|Rom.13:14]], [[Gal.3.27|Gal.3:27]],
2. **to enter, press into**: [[2Ti.3.6|2Ti.3:6]] (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†
(AS)

G1721.def:
**ἔμ-φυτος**, -ον
(ἐμφύω, to implant), [in LXX: ἔ. ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, [[Wis.12.10|Wis.12:10]] * ;]
1. innate ([[Wis.12.10|Wis.12:10]]).
2. **rooted, implanted**: [[Jas.1.21|Jas.1:21]] (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1724.def:
**ἐν-άλιος**, -ον
(also -α, -ον; ἅλς, the sea),
**of the sea**: τὰ ἐ., marine creatures, [[Jas.3.7|Jas.3:7]]†
(AS)

G1710.def:
**ἐμ-πορεύομαι ** depon.
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;]
1. to travel, esp. for business.
2. **to traffc, trade**: [[Jas.4.13|Jas.4:13]]
3. C. accusative of thing(s)
(a) **to traffic in**;
(b) **to import**: ([[Hos.12.1|Hos.12:1]], for יָבַל hoph.).
4. C. accusative of person(s), **to make a gain of**: [[2Pe.2.3|2Pe.2:3]]†
(AS)

G1792.def:
**ἐν-τρυφάω**, ῶ
[in LXX: [[Isa.55.2; 57.4|Isa.55:2 57:4]] (עָנַג hith.), [[Hab.1.10|Hab.1:10]] (קָלַס hith.), [[4Ma.8.8|4Ma.8:8]], etc. ;]
**to revel in**: ἐν-τ. ἀπάταις, [[2Pe.2.13|2Pe.2:13]] (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1739.def:
**ἐν-δώμησις** (Rec. -δόμησις), -εως, ἡ
(δωμάω, to build),
**a build­ing in**: ἡ ἐ. τ. τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, its wall had jasper built into it, [[Rev.21.18|Rev.21:18]] (see MM, _Exp._, xiii; Swete, Ap., l.with).†
(AS)
